title: Can young musicians learn the style from records?
summary: Russell and Perhonas agree people can learn by listening, though he is not hopeful.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Don't you think they can, uh, that, uh, people that are interested in the music can pick up a lot from just listening to it in the records? Yeah, I think so.
That's about the only chance they have now, really.
Could they, uh, could they even learn through just listening? I think so, yeah. If they really want to, yeah.
